concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-orchestration-dlocal]] - 2026-09-16 collected Braintree-hosted dLocal Payment Orchestration guide for existing Braintree merchants, covering Braintree-owned transaction operations, dual-provider setup, country-qualified card requirements, and reconciled lifecycle warnings
warnings: Keep Payment Orchestration distinct from Braintree Forward API; this Braintree-hosted guide is not independent dLocal authority and its status mappings do not prove settlement or funding.
